description: This file defines classes, macros, and functions related to warning reporting control within a software project. It includes mechanisms for categorizing warnings, serializing/deserializing warning data, and managing warning categories and exclusions. The file also contains macro definitions for reporting warnings and out-of-bounds conditions, as well as proxy classes for handling warning events and category configurations.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategory
classes.description: Template class managing bounds and analysis for specific warning categories, including serialization, deserialization, and warning level checks.

classes.name: WarningReportingType
classes.description: Template class representing a warning category with analysis, serialization, and control functionalities, including static methods for configuration and status.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton class acting as a proxy for warning reporting units, managing categories, events, and configuration.

classes.name: ExcludedWarnings
classes.description: Class managing lists of callsigns and modules excluded from warning reports.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Static method to configure warning bounds and specific settings for a category.

methods.name: CategoryName
methods.description: Static method returning the name of the warning category.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Method to analyze a value against category bounds and determine if a warning should be reported.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes category data into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes category data from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts category data to a string representation.

methods.name: IsWarning
methods.description: Checks if the current value qualifies as a warning.

methods.name: WarningReportingType
methods.description: Main class representing a warning category with analysis and control features.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
methods.description: Proxy class managing warning categories, events, and configuration.
